name: Steel Katana
description: A finely balanced hand-forged steel katana with a razor crimson edge.
prompt: A masterwork minimalist 2D flat vector game icon. Pure solid pitch-black silhouette of a curved Japanese samurai katana sword blade tilted diagonally with razor sharp crimson cutting edge. Centered inside a giant solid flat bright crimson red circular sun disc (#FF2035). Pure solid pitch-black background (#000000). Razor-sharp vector edges, ultra-clean silhouettes, high contrast, duotone black and crimson, no 3D rendering, no soft lighting, no text, no watermark.
